Property in the Danube Plain in a quiet village � an excellent investment in the village of Dragomirovo

Near Veliko Tarnovo

House with garage and large garden, only 20 km from Svishtov

We present to you an extremely advantageous property located in the quiet village of Dragomirovo - a place that preserves the spirit of rural coziness and the tranquility of the Danube plain. The village is located only 20 km from Svishtov and 7 km from Ovcha Mogila, famous for its healing mineral water and preferred for rehabilitation and prophylaxis.

The property is situated at the edge of the village - in a quiet area with fresh air, spaciousness and beautiful views of the surrounding nature. The garden is about 1500 sqm, flat and regular in shape, making it extremely convenient for landscaping as well as for construction or future improvements. The space allows for a large garden, recreation area or even additional buildings.

The residential building is one-storey, with an area of about 80 sq.m. Although it needs renovation, the foundation is stable and the roof is in good condition and leak-free - an important prerequisite for future renovation. The layout includes:
- Corridor
- Three separate rooms
- Basement

The wooden floors and window frames, typical of old houses with authentic rural charm, have been preserved.

Additional advantages
- Garage providing convenient access from the main road
- Quiet location, ideal for holidays or permanent living
- Large yard - suitable for farming, raising animals or building a new home
- South facing - light and warmth throughout the day

The property presents an excellent opportunity for clients looking for a quiet village life, renovation investment or second home close to city amenities and healing spas.
